correctness.rationale: For the real octagonal norm max(|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/sqrt(2)), Birkhoff orthogonality has exactly the edge-interior and vertex norming-support cases. The edge case gives squared bounds 49/16 and 2+sqrt(2); the vertex case has four complete admissible arcs and quadratics, two attaining (12+11sqrt(2))/8. The pair x=(1,sqrt(2)-1), y=(-(sqrt(2)-1)/2,1) is a unit orthogonal equality pair. Analytic support reduction covers every direction and branch endpoints. Independently evaluated 128064 octagonal boundary trial pairs and reproduced the sharp value; discrete grid alone is not global proof.
